news.summary: While flights in the United States started resuming on Saturday after all flights were grounded and nearly 6,000 flights were cancelled, authorities warned returning to normal operations would take time. The incident marked only the second time an alert to ground all flights had been issued in US airspace since the 9/11 attacks.

news.summary: In tonight's programme, Gambia's electoral commission has announced the five official candidates for the country's upcoming presidential election. President Adama Barrow is seeking a third term. Tensions continue to rise in Ethiopia following the federal government's appointment of a new head of the Western Tigray region. And the Dakar Youth Olympic Games come to a close after two weeks of intense competition.

news.title: EEUU suspende todos sus vuelos de salida por "motivos de seguridad"
news.summary: Las autoridades de Estados Unidos han suspendido este viernes todas las salidas para todos los aeropuertos de su territorio, alegando "circunstancias extraordinarias y motivos de seguridad", por lo que los vuelos de salida deberán permanecer en tierra hasta nuevo aviso.

news.title: France among five major powers to represent EU in Ukraine talks
news.summary: European Council President Antonio Costa on Friday said that Brussels will send diplomats from the bloc and five countries, including the UK, France, Germany, Italy and Poland, to upcoming Ukraine talks.

news.summary: Turkey and Qatar signed a mutual defence agreement Friday, pledging a unified response to any attack on either country, the two leaders said in a joint statement. The defence pact follows the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement signed by Turkey, Pakistan and Saudi Arabia in August.

news.title: The Downfall of AI’s ‘Rock Star’ Boss, Ukraine: Who speaks for Europe? Protests & Presidents
news.summary: On The World This Week with Gavin Lee, our panel distills the breaking news and global stories of the past 7 days into 45 minutes. Ukraine: Who will speak for Europe? In a week thats seen the first direct talks between Ukraine and Russia since February, with the US in the room and the Europeans relegated to the lobby according to Moscow. A new ‘European Security Architecture’ is discussed.

news.title: UN chief says 'immediate and drastic' emissions cuts needed to avert climate change catastrophe
news.summary: "You cannot build peace on a burning planet," United Nations Secretary-General António Guterres told reporters, stressing that climate change is central to the U.N.'s work because it contributes to geopolitical instability.

news.title: Migrants risk deadly route to Spain’s Canary Islands
